title: A value places a body
description: A native sphere responds to the browser study's height value; an optional mistaken one-metre offset separates its displayed and expected positions. Four physical controls lower, raise, toggle the offset and reset.
limitation: A faithful port of drawPoint, with height 0–3 m in 0.1 m steps and default1.2 m. A visible representation of a point, not a controller for the existing museum coordinate artifact. The +1 m is an incorrect value sent to a local receiver.

title: Read a candidate. Keep a position. Join a pair.
description: Eight given positions become a retained list by the exact distance >=0.8 m test. The learner reads candidates and separately joins retained neighbours, with both route and stored list visible in 3D.
limitation: Fixed candidates from the browser study, not live hand tracking or a replay of a museum drawing. Two-dimensional source positions are embedded on a 3D table with equal units; joining does not alter those positions.
